31570131.desc_art: 上路前不妨痛饮一杯，这有助于对抗烈日、干燥陆地和过于辽阔的海洋。

desc: “美味的蛋糕”虽然不是纳西索斯出走火山岛的最初缘由，但当芭妮芭妮小姐应邀为她烤制蛋糕，她在箱中伙伴的邀请下第一次品尝这甜点后，她认为其可以成为理由之一。|箱中的朋友们在这天举行了一场小型水上运动会，纳西索斯夺得了水中障碍竞速比赛冠军。当她站上领奖台之后，发现自己所收获到的除了奖牌与奖杯，还有伙伴们准备的、藏在奖杯中的礼物。|夜幕降临之后，纳西索斯回到房间，开始整理今天收到的礼物。一串缀有贝壳的珍珠手链令她想起海洋，继而想起火山岛，也想起了她的好友与族人们。

desc2: 受神谕指引的骄傲宁芙，向往冒险与桂冠的小小水仙花，你最乐于探索世界的朋友之一。

character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于20世纪90年代，参展时长逾百年，诞生自3月21日春。原展出地点为爱琴海区域某岛，现巡展于世界各地。

尺寸：55 7/64×31 1/2×12 3/32in.
介质：涟漪
香调：水生调 水仙 梨 杜松 无花果 海水
灵感：妖灵的渴想[兽] 水泽仙女

character_data.title: 水仙花河岸
character_data.text:
一件带有立体水仙勾花的针织披肩，亲肤而柔软，不具备保暖功能。不规则的下摆设计与其上点缀的黄白小花，使其本身潭水般的绿色也不显沉闷。
她熟悉这抹绿色，如同熟悉生于山谷的水仙花。她曾漫步溪边，朝水流所向的地方尽力眺望，想象自己某天闯入火山岛以外的世界，如同水滴汇入海洋。

character_data.title: 少女饰品套组
character_data.text:
一组风格各异但搭配效果良好的饰品，含有腕饰三件与发饰若干。
受访者曾多次在火山岛纪念品商店购买饰品，玻璃珠手链与星星发夹构成了她对火山岛外“潮流”的认知。同族的宁芙们鲜有和她品味相同者，但这一点不曾困扰她——她结识了能够一起出走火山岛的好友。尽管友人们馈赠的饰品总能扩充她的收藏，她仍乐意自己挑选。

character_data.title: “赐福”仿品
character_data.text:
一件手工制作的饰品，以模仿鳞片的贝壳作为吊坠，其上缤纷的光彩来自于某种工业涂料。
受访者从不避讳该单品是一件仿品，还会主动提及它的做工：“它竟然有和‘赐福’一样的光彩，形状和大小也一起还原了……就算他们不告诉我是谁做的，我也看见过荷米斯划伤的手、阿波罗藏起的颜料，还有忒弥斯购买银链的票据！所以，它依旧在这里，纪念着我们共同的伟大经历。”

character_data.title: 在颂诗之间
character_data.text:
最受关心的总是那些伟大的存在。早在公元前8世纪，人们就为众神编纂了详细的谱系。奥德修斯的故事在口耳相传间演变，又经过有心人汇编，时至今日，人人都可以轻易地翻开书页，回顾英雄那脍炙人口的伟大旅程。
但除此之外，还有许许多多的精灵和仙子。她们是骄傲的俄刻阿诺斯的女儿，既不参与人类的战争，也不卷入诸神的纠纷，只是唱着自己的歌，优雅地游过故事的缝隙。

该娅诞下了高耸的丛山和水泽，这些地方日后便成为了宁芙的居所。她们为自己的花冠采撷桃金娘、康乃馨、薄荷与百里香，将露水穿缀为衣，以轻盈的脚步终日漫游在群山和溪谷之间。
宁芙们的术法止步于化为植物等小小把戏，她们照看初生的神祇或英雄，收取一绺铰下的头发，对他们的力量却毫无欲求。
那些抑扬格六音步的诗行之间偶见她们的踪迹，其原因无非是遭到了诸神无伤大雅的戏弄，或是反过来戏弄了过路的英雄……

这样自由自在的日子纳西索斯过了很久，直到她报名参加了那一年的水上运动会并取得了最后一名的好成绩。
最后一名吗？！
骄傲的宁芙尖叫着离开了会场，不得不开始审视自己的完美生活。

character_data.title: 排名不分先后
character_data.text:
喜欢的东西：
多里斯
泉水宁芙的冒险故事
平静湖面的倒影
退潮时的沙滩
英雄壁画
阿波罗无酒精特调

害怕的东西：

不见边际的海面
科里西亚洞穴
需要挺身而出的时刻
划伤掌蹼
幸运转盘里的炸弹
发起挑战的酒吧客人
输掉比赛

讨厌的东西：
蒜泥配腌海虾
紫水母
沉默寡言的人
自言自语
在陆地上跑步
“涟漪”
独自游泳
赫多涅

character_data.title: 英雄访谈
character_data.text:
白雪松：你好，火山岛的新“英雄”。
纳西索斯：哼哼！你是来传播我取胜的伟大事迹的吗？那得从一个睡前故事说起，不，还得再往前，那是一个遥远的黄昏——
白雪松：看来，你有许多故事要讲。
纳西索斯：当然！我有许多细节可以分享，读者们一定想知道我们如何进行密切合作，以及在最后的紧要关头，我，伟大的纳西索斯，又是如何拿下提丰之眼的。
纳西索斯：我已经准备好了5分钟的获奖感言，稍等，让我戴上桂冠……可以开始了吗？
白雪松：比起你的成就，我们更关心你自己。例如，听说你进入体育界的道路并不顺利，是怎样的训练帮助你克服困难的？
纳西索斯：训练……没错，我的确进行了一定的训练！嗯！泉水宁芙们都很支持我！
白雪松：那么，你对未来有何想法？比如专精项目？
纳西索斯：唔，专精项目，这个嘛……
白雪松：下一届水上运动会时，有信心打败老对手赫多涅吗？
纳西索斯：下一届……
白雪松：你听起来要哭了。
纳西索斯：敬、敬请期待！我一定会带来更加亮眼的成绩！

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 无与伦比的伟大英雄“纳西索斯”前来造访！灯光、掌声、赞美！#0|……还没准备好吗？#6.2
character_voice.encontent: The great Narcissus has finally graced this place with her arrival! Ready the spotlight, the applause, the praise!#0|... Hello? Where's my adoring fans?#9.5

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 最好是碧空无云的日子，#0|拨开那片芦苇与菖蒲，湖面上映出我的倒影——#2.4|天！多么完美的一张脸呀！#7.8
character_voice.encontent: Mm, nothing beats a bright, cloudless day!#0|Perfect for sneaking off to the reed-ringed pond and paying my reflection a visit—#3.9|after all, where else could I hope to find a face so perfect?#9.8

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 泉水宁芙是生长缓慢的种族，而我的成长速度也比其他族人都要慢……#0|那么长的生命，要做些什么好呢？#7|哼哼，我决定我要和所有人都不一样！#11.8
character_voice.encontent: Spring Nymphs mature slowly by nature, and I seem to be the slowest of them all ...#0|At times, I don't even know what to do with this long childhood, let alone how I'll live the rest of my life ... #8.1|Well! That only means I'm destined for something none of the others could ever manage!#17.3

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 维尔汀，别忽视我！我们可是“英雄挚友”！#0|既是得胜的大英雄，又是感情深厚的好朋友，我们之间怎么能只有沉默呢？#3.5
character_voice.encontent: Vertin, Vertin! How could you turn such a cold shoulder to your companion after our heroic voyage?#0|After everything we've been through together, there's no way we're running out of things to talk about now!#8.5

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 你终于来了！别忘了，你诚挚的朋友，纳西索斯，大部分时间也在想念你！#0|快快告诉我，今天有什么新的见闻？#6.6
character_voice.encontent: Ah, there you are! Just in time before your poor Narcissus wastes away missing you.#0|Come, sit—tell me all about your adventures out there!#7.3

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 我躺在草坡上，在清晨的风与阳光中睡着了。#0|有东西在窸窸窣窣地拱着我的头发，#4.2|我知道是那些毛茸茸的金毛羊，它们经常误把我当作同类……#7.4
character_voice.encontent: I like to sprawl out on the hillside facing the sea and drift off to sleep beneath the warm sun.#0|But every once in a while, a ram would nudge me awake; #7.1|I guess they see my golden locks and take me for one of their lambs!#12

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 我彻夜不归，直到厄俄斯用玫瑰色的手指点亮了天空，#0|我曾在湖水之下看着这样的朝霞。#5.2|现在，我与真实的天空之间，不会再有任何阻隔。#9.2
character_voice.encontent: When the water was warm enough, I'd spend my nights just beneath the surface looking up at the sky,#0|just waiting for Eos to swipe away the darkness with her rosy fingers. #6.6|Even though I spend most of my time on land, I still take time to see the sunrise now and again—hard not to be awed by her handiwork.#12.2

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 我小时候被油灯燎过鱼鳍，一度以为它们长不回来了！#0|族人们惊慌失措，责怪我怎么敢爬上岸去，借着夜色里的火光看那些壁画……#4.2|可那多有趣呀！我的鱼鳍也长回来了，毫无损失！不是吗？#10.4
character_voice.encontent: I burned the membranes of my fingers on an oil lamp once. At the time, I feared my hands would be scarred forever!#0|Ah, the scolding I got when my family learned I'd been sneaking out of the pond to look at those frescoes! #9.8|But I had fun, and they grew back in the end, so everything turned out just fine, didn't it?#17.1

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 有很长一段时间，我只想着自己的事情。#0|我的世界里只有自己的倒影，我不需要任何其他东西了……#3.6|可树梢上的小鸮为何一直咕咕叫？#8.9|水仙花瓣最终离开了花蕊，那究竟是枯萎，还是新生？我想要知道！#12.2
character_voice.encontent: There was a time in my life when I thought of nothing but myself.#0|I wasn't curious about anything else around me.#4.5|But I've grown; now I'll listen for the chirping of newly-hatched owlets in a tree, #8.2|and wonder at where the fallen petals of the daffodils blow when they catch in the wind ... I can't wait to find out!#15

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 这里的鳍很脆弱，所以泉水宁芙总是会小心翼翼地保护它们。#0|但我有很多次“不小心”，它们似乎也没什么变化……#6|维尔汀，你当然可以碰它们——这对你来说也是一件新鲜事吧！#10
character_voice.encontent: The membrane here is very fragile, so we're always careful with them.#0|Or ... well, I try to, at least. I've torn them a few times but they always grow back ... #5.9|Oh? Yes, of course! Touch away! They have a unique texture, wouldn't you agree?#15.4

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 我和你不一样，我的手指无法真的分开——#0|但我们还是可以握手呀！握握手，我的好朋友！#3.5
character_voice.encontent: Webbing or not, we Spring Nymphs still know how to shake hands!#0|Just like any other species, it's a gesture of friendship and goodwill!#4.5

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 我去了巴黎、伦敦还有米兰！#0|在时尚之都里采集众多灵感后，才有了这一身衣服！#2.7|当然，我没有忘记湖水中的涟漪和一直陪伴我的花，#7|以及这些亮晶晶的、新新世界里的小饰品！#11.1
character_voice.encontent: I've been to Paris, to London, and Milan—all the great cities of fashion!#0|They gave me all kinds of inspirations about what I could do with this outfit. #6.7|But of course, I didn't forget my origins—#11.7|I managed to add in these ripple-like patterns and flowers for good measure!#15

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 我去了巴黎、伦敦还有米兰！#0|在时尚之都里采集众多灵感后，才有了这一身衣服！#2.7|当然，我没有忘记湖水中的涟漪和一直陪伴我的花，#7|以及这些亮晶晶的、新新世界里的小饰品！#11.1
character_voice.encontent: I've been to Paris, to London, and Milan—all the great cities of fashion!#0|They gave me all kinds of inspirations about what I could do with this outfit. #6.7|But of course, I didn't forget my origins—#11.7|I managed to add in these ripple-like patterns and flowers for good measure!#15

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 我最最欣赏我自己！如果我游得比较慢，那就是我在等待一个好时机；#0|如果胜利总是遥远，那就是路上有不容错过的风景。一切总是如此的——刚刚好！#6.1
character_voice.encontent: What do I prize most? Why, myself, of course! Do I swim slowly? That's so I don't miss the good things along the way!#0|Do I look like a lost cause in games? I'm just waiting for the wind to turn in my favor! It is all a matter of timing—my time will come!#10

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 你的眼睛如同湖水一样清澈，胸前的宝石也有不逊于波涛之眼的光芒，#0|气质更是古典、优雅而不失高贵……现在轮到你来夸夸我了！#6.2
character_voice.encontent: Your eyes are like the clearest lake, and the jewel on your jabot gleams no less than the "Eye of the Tides."#0|Even your bearing is ever so graceful ... Now—your turn. Praise me!#8

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 我从不在乎我长得比其他的泉水宁芙要慢！#0|但是，维尔汀，#3.2|如果我在那时知道我们会成为朋友，我就会祈祷时间变得更快一些、再快一些！#4.3|快长大，快游出去，快去遇见维尔汀！#10.4
character_voice.encontent: I've noticed time moves more slowly for me than for the other Spring Nymph, but I've never let it bother me!#0|A-Although, I think—#8.2|I think maybe I would've wished otherwise, had I known I would one day meet you! #13|That way we could have met sooner!#18.6

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 那个抓着气球的女孩——她真酷！#0|她送给我气球，这是不是“想要成为朋友”的讯号？#3.6|当然可以！不过那气球里的东西应该只是装饰……对、对吧？#7.8
character_voice.encontent: That girl with the balloon ... she has such a unique charm to her!#0|She gave me one of her balloons—does that mean that she wants to be friends? #6|I would most readily agree! Only ... that liquid inside the balloon ... It will stay in there, right?#11.9

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我在箱子里到处游玩，遇到一些新朋友。我给那些生活在宁静湖中的族人们写信，告诉他们我的新生活。#0|他们会看完那些信吗？#9.4|也许有一天，他们会想看看不一样的世界……#12.1
character_voice.encontent: I've been making the most of my time here, meeting all kinds of people every day and writing home about them.#0|Do you think the other Spring Nymphs would care to hear about life here? #7.8|I hope they do—it'll be nice for them to read about something different from our lake, I think ...#12.6

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 阿波罗和忒弥斯都说我太容易过分相信某种东西了。#0|该轻巧地从神谕中习得智慧，该有所保留地顺应溪流的指引……#4|可当我下定决心跃入大海的时候，我已经知道——我会用尽全力去做所有事情。#10.5
character_voice.encontent: Apollo and Themis are always nagging me to be more careful with prophecy and fate.#0|Apparently, I ought to think more about things before I choose to believe them ... #5.4|but believing in my oracle is what brought you to us; it's in my nature to trust in what I believe wholeheartedly.#10.2

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 快来快来！我想站在正中央！#0
character_voice.encontent: Come on! Put me right in the center of it all!#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 闪亮登场！#0
character_voice.encontent: You have been graced by my presence!#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 亮晶晶！#0
character_voice.encontent: Sparkle-sprinkle!#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 有我在，有我在～#0
character_voice.encontent: Narcissus is here!#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 可靠的纳西索斯！#0
character_voice.encontent: You can always bet on me!#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 这是最重要的一部分……#0
character_voice.encontent: Now our adventure reaches its climax ...#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 有惊喜！#0
character_voice.encontent: Surprise!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 看下面！#0
character_voice.encontent: Oops—watch your step!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 一些涟漪……#0
character_voice.encontent: Onwards, gentle ripples ...#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 流经你和我！#0
character_voice.encontent: Embrace the flow!#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 英雄，名为纳西索斯！#0
character_voice.encontent: Then came forth your savior, Narcissus!#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 我才不会逃走！#0
character_voice.encontent: I won't run!#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 该躲开的是你！#0
character_voice.encontent: You should run, NOW!#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 我就说吧！只要有我们在，胜利总会相随！#0
character_voice.encontent: See? I knew we would prevail!#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 真奇妙！我感到更加……跃跃欲试了！#0|尽管前方是大雨和风暴，尽管那会是更多的危险与疼痛……#4.2|脆弱的鱼鳍像枝叶一样向这世界的远方舒展着，好像正在说：“纳西索斯，我们不害怕！”#9.5
character_voice.encontent: I feel incredible!#0|Like I could throw myself straight into any storm the sea sends my way! #2.4|Ah—just look at my fins! They're telling me, "Narcissus, you were born for this!"#7.4

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 第一次浸入海水之中时，我的掌蹼疼得要命，#0|像在抱怨我不该前往大海！#3.5|但现在它们变得更有韧性了！因为我后来在海里游了一次又一次……#6.6|大家都适应得很好呢！#13.4
character_voice.encontent: The first time I dove into salt water, my webbings stung terribly!#0|I thought they'd dry up and fall off—that they only belonged in rivers and springs.#4.8|But look at them now! They've toughened up wonderfully. Gods, I love the sea ...#10.9| and my fins seem to enjoy it just as much as I do!#17.6

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 第一次浸入海水之中时，我的掌蹼疼得要命，#0|像在抱怨我不该前往大海！#3.5|但现在它们变得更有韧性了！因为我后来在海里游了一次又一次……#6.6|大家都适应得很好呢！#13.4
character_voice.encontent: The first time I dove into salt water, my webbings stung terribly!#0|I thought they'd dry up and fall off—that they only belonged in rivers and springs.#4.8|But look at them now! They've toughened up wonderfully. Gods, I love the sea ...#10.9| and my fins seem to enjoy it just as much as I do!#17.6

skin.name: 纳西索斯
skin.skinDescription: 火山岛运动会的第一位宁芙冠军！……算是吧？

skin.name: 纳西索斯
skin.skinDescription: 临行前夜，河岸覆满露水。

1391051.content: 呼、呼……呀！没想到，能在晨跑时碰到你！
箱中的生活当然很舒适，不过，我也不能轻易停止对体能的锤炼——
为了我注定的胜利！下一次水上运动会上，我绝对、绝对要赢过赫多涅！
那当然！比起昨天，我跑过这段路程的时间，足足少了两秒呢！
多亏可燃点小姐帮我记下。或许我可以听取她的建议，去乌卢鲁运动会上看看。
我有预感，说不定在他们的项目里，我的天赋才能被充分发挥！
太好啦！我也相信你，我相信你识人的眼光！
我们宁芙拥有的时间很多，这意味着，我可以再前进一点、等待一个好时机，然后——在领奖台大放异彩！
怎么样，维尔汀？下一次水上运动会，要不要再和我一队？

1391052.content: 维尔汀，看——寄往火山岛湖畔的信！
我要把这里碰到的新鲜事一股脑全写进去。唔，记忆的角落里，也许还有别的……
拜托了，帮我一起想想，假如……假如你是我的话，你还会对他们说些什么？
朋友，对啊——朋友！我走过世界上这么多地方，他们的故事却仍令我讶异。
芭卡洛儿！她的乐器竟这样巧妙，旋律如流水有百般姿态，比泉水宁芙的歌声还要丰富！
想想就令人兴奋不已，维尔汀——你会与这么多、和她一样有趣的朋友一起冒险！
好主意！说实话，我也很想念大家……
湖面倒映出宁芙们围坐轻唱的身影，涟漪一圈圈散开，像为大家打着拍子一样……离开火山岛后，我时常做这样的梦。
不过，我会将有关族人们的回忆珍藏在心底。至于未来——我会像你一样，去掀起自己的波浪！

1391051.content: 至少你总会赢过前一天的自己

1391052.content: 不如也问问他们的近况？
